case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Andreas Dralveck,

Thank you for your offer of €36.00 per unit and for the care you have taken in reviewing our request for the HX series pump shaft. We value our reliable cooperation and appreciate your commitment to quality. The index PPI-D351 changed -3.7 % from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). On that basis, we propose EUR 25.65 per unit, payment 14 days net, a lead time of 28 days. We hope these terms provide a sound basis for an agreement that works for both sides and would welcome your thoughts on our proposal.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
